title: `Core\Html`'s parser walks caller-sized input with no deadline poll.
text: `rule:http-server/time-is-bounded-inside-a-helper` requires a helper whose runtime scales with its input to poll the request's deadline. `parse` and `parse_in_page` run html5ever over a whole caller-sized document, and nothing in the walk reads the deadline, so a large value can run past the CPU-time limit inside one call. Closing it walks the input in pieces through `nvs_runtime::bounded_loop`, or polls through `nvs_runtime::DeadlineBatch` where another crate drives the loop, and adds a test that the member is the deadline's FATAL once the deadline has passed.
